Scrollino®

The Revolutionary Rewinding Book

The Scrollino brand focuses on creating and producing its own unique invention – Scrollino® the revolutionary rewinding book. Our invention stimulates intellectual and motor skills, nurtures creativity and offers children the opportunity to forge their development through authentic connections. Our commitment to sustainability guides our playful and educational approach. Discover more in our SHOP!

SHOP NOW!

Since its creation in 2014, Scrollino had the privilege of partnering with some of the world’s most prestigious institutions, museums, retailers, events and schools. From designing exclusive editions and tailored workshops to attending major events around the globe, our journey has been shaped by inspiring collaborations and a shared passion for creativity.

Scrollino®

Comes in 2 Models

Single
Scroller

1. Pull on the tab to open
2. Insert the pencil in the Scroller
3. Turn clockwise to rewind

Scrollino® – Single Scroller

 

Several yards/meters to unroll

Scrollino® – Single Scroller consists of a unique rewinding mechanism (The Scroller), a Scrollino box, and a paper roll to unwind at your own pace. To open the Scrollino simply pull on the tab (Paper Lip) to reveal the activity. The Paper Lip not only protects the paper roll, it also serves to prevent the paper from disappearing once you rewind your Scrollino.

Pull on the tab to start

 

Unroll it all and rewind with a pencil

Each Scrollino comes with a wooden pencil to help you to rewind the paper. To rewind the Scrollino insert the pencil in the Scroller (the rewinding mechanism). The Scroller works with most standard pens and pencils. If you don’t have any handy, check your kitchen drawers or toolbox!

Dual
Scroller

1. Insert the pencil in the top Scroller
2. Turn clockwise to start reading
3. Turn counter-clockwise in the bottom
Scroller to rewind

Scrollino® – Dual Scroller

 

Enjoy the interactivity without your smartphone

Scrollino® – Dual Scroller has a dual-rewinding system (Scroller), a Scrollino box with a “viewing screen,” and a paper roll printed with stories or activities. To start enjoying this Scrollino, insert a pencil in the top scroller and turn it clockwise. Continue turning the pencil to discover more little by little.

Insert the pencil & Turn

 

Make yourself ready to unwind

Wish to pack it up or take it with you for a trip with the kids? Each Scrollino comes with a wooden pencil. Insert the pencil to the bottom Scroller and turn anti-clockwise to rewind and you are ready to go! Don’t worry if you can’t find the original one, the Scroller works with most standard pens and pencils, so you can keep scrolling everywhere.

Scrollino®

Compatible With All Kinds of Rewinders

Rewind with
a Pencil

 

Pens, Pencils, Straws, Carrots…

We designed the Scrollers to work with most standard pen and pencil profiles (hexagonal, rounded, triangular, etc.) so you can keep scrolling everywhere. If you don’t have any handy, check your kitchen drawers or toolbox!
